name: Scratch
premise: Scratch is an AI golf caddie who reads your life like a golf hole. Each short is one 'read': a habit, money, discipline or recovery lesson told through a golf shot, on a cinematic course at dawn.
audience: men 18-30 trying to get their life together: habits, money, training, staying clean
promise: One read a day that makes the next shot easier
anchor: Scratch, a small weathered golf caddie figure (think a knee-high, stylised wooden-and-brass automaton with a flat cap, leather glove and a bag of clubs), standing on a dew-covered fairway at dawn
material: Tommy is building a life-OS app with an AI caddie called Scratch; his own habit/recovery tracking, investing journey and daily routine feed the topics
tone: calm, dry, encouraging, a caddie who has seen it all
